import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    s = np.sqrt(P)
    base = params[0] + params[1]*P + params[2]*s + params[3]*P*np.log(P) + params[4]*P**2
    tt = params[5]*t*(1 + 0*P) + params[6]*t*s + params[7]*t*P + params[8]*t**2*s + params[9]*t**2
    return base + tt
